en.name: Mengpo
en.ability: Each night*, choose a player: if they are alive, they must choose to lose their ability or die and keep their ability until dusk.

zh.name: 孟婆
zh.ability: 每个夜晚*，你要选择一名玩家：如果他存活，那么他要选择让自己失去能力，或死亡并保留能力直到下个黄昏。
